common: Generate a seamless tileable square texture. Flat top-down orthographic view, zero perspective, no cast shadows, perfectly even flat lighting. Saturated candy colours, clean smooth vector-like shapes, playful toy aesthetic. The pattern repeats perfectly: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. No border, no frame, no vignette, no text, no logo, no watermark. The pattern fills the entire square edge to edge.

slots.name: checker-blocks
slots.prompt: Seamless tileable square texture. Strictly orthographic top-down view of a flat painted vinyl mat, absolutely no perspective, no vanishing point, no camera tilt, no cast shadow, no ambient occlusion, no vignette, perfectly uniform flat studio lighting across the whole surface. Content: a crisp checkerboard of 8 by 8 square cells filling the entire frame edge to edge, alternating flat matte pure white #FFFFFF and flat light neutral grey #C9C9C9, hard clean edges, corners of each cell very slightly softened by a radius of 3 percent of the cell size, no bevel, no highlight, no gradient, no grain, no noise, no outline. This is a MOTIF layer: values only, near neutral, colour will be supplied later by the material it is applied to. Pattern must wrap exactly on all four edges so opposite sides align. No border, no frame, no margin, no text, no numbers, no watermark, no logo. High resolution, 1:1.
